description:
The subject requirement is for the acquisition of National Stock Number (NSN) 4910-01-536-8795. The Federal Stock Class (FSC) is 4910. Reference the attached spreadsheet for NSN information. If interested in this requirement, please complete the attached Market Survey and corresponding Excel spreadsheet. Any company interested in the subject requirements of who has questions concerning the qualification process should respond via email by April 23, 2026. Please provide the location of the manufacturer (City and State or County if applicable). Also provide a Point of Contact for the manufacturer(s) if available.

All information can be submitted to Karen Sherrill at Karen.Sherrill@dla.mil, Phone 614-693-0152.

Thank you for your support.
